title: Workday
hint: The chief engineer opens the workday and closes it with their password. Each service has its ATS and three start signatures: without them nothing about the train can be filled. Once the day is closed, technicians can no longer change anything of that day.
noDayHint: The chief engineer must open the workday before services, ATS and observations can be recorded.
lockedHint: Workday closed: technicians can no longer change readings, photos or records of this day. Only the chief engineer or an administrator can reopen it, and it is logged.
genericError: Could not save. Check the data.

works.title: Today's work
works.hint: Service visits and corrective jobs of the date, with who did them and when.
works.empty: No work recorded on this date yet.

observations.title: Field observations
observations.hint: The photo first, then whether the finding shows in it, and last what was done.
observations.isVisible: 2. Is the finding visible in the photo?

sign.closeHint: Type your password to sign the close. From then on technicians cannot change data of this day.
sign.reopenHint: Reopening is signed with your password and the reason goes to the audit log.

jobs.title: Services of the day
jobs.hint: A service is one job the staff does on one train. Until it has its three start signatures, nobody can fill data of that train.
jobs.empty: No services recorded in this workday yet.

job.notFoundBody: Go back to the workday and open it from the list of services.
job.subtitle: Workday of {{date}} · Order: {{order}}
job.pendingHint: Start signatures missing ({{signed}} of 3): this train's fields stay locked.
job.inProgressHint: In progress since {{time}}. The train's fields are enabled.
job.startHint: The production engineer, the service leader and the plant supervisor sign before starting. The third signature enables the train's fields.
job.unlockHint: Enables the train's fields without the three start signatures. Who did it and why is logged.
job.signHint: Type the signer's name and have them sign in the box with a finger, stylus or mouse.
job.signCrewHint: {{name}} signs in the box with a finger, stylus or mouse.

ats.title: 2. Job Safety Analysis (ATS)
ats.hint: The client's format: header, risk category, PPE, tools and the steps with their hazards, risks, IPERC evaluation and controls.
ats.activity: Name of the activity and/or job
ats.ppePlaceholder: Helmet, safety glasses, gloves, steel-toe boots…
ats.addHazard: Add another hazard of this step

crew.title: 3. Crew
crew.hint: Everyone who performs the service signs the ATS. The service does not close without every signature.
crew.name: Name

closing.title: 4. Closing the service
closing.hint: The service's end time is the moment the chief engineer or an administrator signs its close with their password, with the ATS complete and signed.
closing.notStarted: The service has not started: the start signatures are missing.
closing.ready: ATS complete and signed: the service can be closed.
closing.done: Closed on {{end}} by {{who}}. That is the service's end time.
closing.modalHint: Type your password to sign the close. The time of this signature becomes the service's end time.
